title: Finite native loader roles; interface proposal, not a source seal
x-core-invariants: This draft is an interface only. complete=false or any pending item refuses activation.

The tracked policy path is som-rs/scripts/hosted_readiness/native_active_roles.json. Its exact bytes must occur in each real numbered native source-admission operational_sources map. It contains no self SHA or commit field, so no source-seal cycle is required.

design is the exact frozen117-source/327-edge/16-root inventory data, compared by canonical hash. It is provenance, not the final candidate map. sources and static_edges must describe the complete rederived actual integrated candidate closure, including new helpers and all selected fragment sources.

Every source is safe relative, regular, physical, single-linked, exact Git blob/mode, no PYC. Every executable role belongs to the actual native admitted Python map. Module/name/package pairs cannot conflict.
Every closure includes its own role and all actual static targets, parent packages, binding roles and fixed manual dependencies. All member bytes/ASTs are checked before any member executes.

seed roles are exactly bootstrap.graph, bootstrap.authority, bootstrap.core and bootstrap.entry. They reuse only actual opaque pre-exec ledger records. They never bless an old main or a marker-bearing module.

entry roles use module __main__, package empty and is_package=false. Only bootstrap.entry/_trusted_run may originate initial entry execution. argv is bounded text data and never selects a source path.

A fragment requires selector; other kinds forbid it. ast_sha256 hashes ast.dump(ast.Module(body=selected_original_nodes,type_ignores=[]),include_attributes=False). Names select whole original definitions/assignments in original source order; bodies are never rewritten. The original source must already use future annotations.

Bindings are fixed tracked recipes. No public globals/callback/raw/code/path argument exists. local-instance and local-data inspect only the authenticated originating frame, after fixed bridges. Exact source-owned type and fields are required; foreign callables are refused.

context-module bridge is only the registered Context.module function from full_product_context.py. Fragment-wrapper bridges must be exact registered source functions and validate source_local/names_local against the requested fixed fragment. An unknown immediate foreign frame refuses; it is never skipped to find a deeper trusted frame.

imports match actual original AST name/level/fromlist for the caller role. result and from_roles reference fixed roles. Unrelated imports delegate to the actual built-in importer and existing RawQaFinder.

The private group has exactly the four fixed sources/names for retained/API/live/Node. Its retained_evidence and producer sys.modules aliases are private read-only views; collector-global names remain untouched. Producer is a separate fixed dependency role, never an extra group member.

Original two common.py to rust_build_negative_cases specs remain exact. The same actual finder and checked_spec objects stay installed. Only a precise owned/source-bound manual-loader method adapter transition is allowed and verified through the actual code/globals ledger.
Source may seal before products. All product/compiler/whole acceptance flags remain false. Historical/preparation callers are not changed by this native-only core.
